proposals.title: Coverage-admitted disjoint-rate window expansion applied to pair views
proposals.mechanism: Freeze a finite1/7/30d ladder and calendar-only whole-mature-training admission. At each user/anchor, expand a complete window when raw user-view rates in its current suffix and disjoint older annulus have fixed minimum support and fixed relative discrepancy; apply selected width to raw pair-view rate. No learned decay, fitted threshold or outcome-guided search.
proposals.prediction: May produce useful compact learner input by shortening history during activity change; can lose short-term detail, react to duplicates or choose noisy short history. Fixed basis contains its information; no new-information or optimal-scale claim.
proposals.nearest_source_free_experiment: Compile calendar/coverage gate and exact selector with no DB. Check raw endpoints, duplicates, global-peer permutations/future suffix, zero versus unavailable/gapped coverage, invalid annuli and checked arithmetic; record demanded parents and forbid excluded30d reads. Compare strong fixed basis reconstruction/information-loss examples.
proposals.task1benefit: Make automatic temporal-scale choice, exact availability and overlapping-parent costs explicit; statically avoid unsupported scale work and test a compact representation against a strong fixed-window basis.
